note: Wooded campground below the bluffs where the Trempealeau River meets the Mississippi; the west loop's sites (about 34-47) sit in woods above Trempealeau Bay, with a canoe launch nearby. Bike path from the campground to the Great River State Trail. Four walk-in group sites. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page + campground map read: 102 sites (electric on the E sites), seasonal showers/flush toilets/dump, vault toilets, water, all reservable. Bayview kept: west-loop spurs ~30 m from Trempealeau Bay under continuous canopy (stored 'open overlook' evidence not seen on imagery). Pin ~200 m south of the loops' centre (keep). Year-round season, 45-ft max and no-water-hookups are unsourced (note prose); fees/amps/lengths unread (GoingToCamp refuses).
flags: WATERFRONT: bayview KEPT (not --AWH). On the DNR map sites 34E-38 and 41-47E line the road along Trempealeau Bay; on Esri imagery their spurs end ~30-35 m from the bay's vegetated east shore (e.g. ~44.0268,-91.4855 for the sites around 43-45) under continuous broadleaf canopy, so no open-ground site and no on-water value. The stored evidence's 'open overlook set back across marsh' does not match the imagery (dense woods); replacement: 'DNR map + Esri imagery: west-loop sites ~34-47 line Trempealeau Bay, spurs ~30 m from the vegetated shore under continuous canopy -> bayview (filtered), not bayfront --Claude'. The canoe launch is day use.
